==Summary==

:{{pov|[[Perrin Aybara]]}}

Perrin is in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' in the flesh, chasing after [[Slayer]]. They battle in the storm clouds lacing the World of Dreams. They are in the south, close to the [[Sea of Storms]], far from [[Shayol Ghul]].

In attempts to lull and distract each other, they discuss the [[Dark One]] and his rewards, in addition to Slayer's predilection for hunting wolves. While Perrin is distracted, Slayer attacks, forcing him underwater. Perrin struggles to get free, finally freezing the water solid so he can shift to the shore. He is exhausted; he has been too long without sleep in the real world, as days have passed in the real world for the hours Perrin has experienced in ''Tel'aran'rhiod''. One of Slayer's arrows pierces Perrin's shoulder and he shifts further away, injured. 

:{{pov|[[Zarine ni Bashere t'Aybara]]}}

Faile waits in the city of Tar Valon for supplies with fifty members of the [[Band of the Red Hand|Band]] and with [[Cha Faile]]. Secretly, she is to collect the [[Horn of Valere]] and deliver it to [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat]]. [[Laras]] brings Faile the Horn disguised as a chest of [[Two Rivers]] tabac and Faile's party move across the [[Jualdhe]] Bridge to the [[Traveling|Traveling grounds]] outside the city. 

As [[Berisha Terakuni|Berisha]] prepares to open a gateway for the [[Field of Merrilor]] a [[bubble of evil]] strikes. Sharp black crystal spikes erupt from the earth. Berisha hurriedly opens a gateway and Faile's party flees through. Berisha is mortally injured but holds the weave long enough for Faile to follow. 

On the other side, Faile realizes she is not at Merrilor; they are in the [[Great Blight|Blight]]. 

:{{pov|[[Aviendha]]}}

Aviendha is in an [[Aiel]] tent in the valley of Thakan'dar. It is days since [[Rand al'Thor|Rand]] has entered Shayol Ghul, but Aviendha notes that [[Far Dareis Mai|Maidens]] guarding the path have worked four hours shifts on the mountain only to find when they descend that eight hours have passed, she wonders how much time has passed in the [[Pit of Doom|Pit]]. 

[[Melaine]] is close by; she is not fighting as she is close to giving birth. She, along with [[gai'shain]] help with the war effort by carrying water and helping to bring the injured to the [[Healing]] camp set up in [[Mayene]]. There is a lull in the fighting, the [[Shadow]] appears to be waiting for something.

Aviendha senses a woman channeling in the camp. [[Windfinder|Windfinders]] not working on holding the tempest at bay with the [[Bowl of the Winds]] make camp with the army. However, channeling is forbidden in camp for even smallest uses so Aviendha investigates. She finds the source of the channeling at [[Darlin Sisnera|Darlin]]'s tent. Aviendha notices [[Samma N'Sei|three Aiel men]] at the tent and believes them friends until they attack her. She notes they wear red veils and at least one can channel. Aviendha is captured but [[Cadsuane Melaidhrin|Cadsuane]] arrives and rescues Aviendha, having sensed the men channeling with her [[paralis-net]]. The two investigate the original source of channeling and find [[Hessalam]], who attacks then flees. 

They both sense more channeling around the camp, more male channelers at the same time the [[Trolloc|Trollocs]] attack. Aviendha realises the Aiel men are those sent to the Blight on learning they can channel and explains this to [[Amys]] and [[Sorilea]]. Aviendha controls a circle and sets [[Damer Flinn|Flinn]] the task of watching for male channelers. [[Darlin Sisnera|Darlin]] and the army concentrate on the Trollocs while Aviendha and the channelers try to take out the [[Dreadlords]]. They don't need fancy tactics; they just need to hold the valley.
